title: Test-Driven Development Compliance
description: Detects production code added without corresponding test coverage, test files that appear after implementation files (test-after pattern), and common TDD anti-patterns. Source: obra/superpowers TDD skill, adapted to A-CyberSolutions TypeScript/Node stack.

rules.message: Mocking return values instead of testing real behavior. TDD principle: test real code, not mock behavior.
rules.remediation: Replace mock chain with a real stub or fixture. Only mock at system boundaries (network, filesystem, Docker socket).

rules.message: Vague test name detected. Test names must describe the behavior being verified, not the mechanism.
rules.remediation: Rename to describe the specific behavior: 'rejects empty email', 'retries failed operations 3 times', etc.

rules.message: Skipped or deferred test detected. R17: Zero Technical Debt — deferred tests are invisible regression risks.
rules.remediation: Either implement the test now or move the gap to docs/wiki/ActiveTasks.md as a backlog item. Remove skip marker.

rules.message: Empty or comment-only catch block in test file. Silent failures in tests hide real bugs.
rules.remediation: Assert on the caught error or use expect(() => ...).toThrow(). Never swallow exceptions in tests.
